headline: Strong Q 2; better growth prospects ahead

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Pearl Global Industries (PEAGL) CMP: ₹ 1,337 Target ₹ 1,600 (19%) Target Period: 12 months November 9, 2026 Strong Q 2; better growth prospects ahead About the stock : Pearl Global Industries Ltd.

Q 2F Y2 7 performance : PGIL consolidated revenues (adjusting for incremental revenues from value-added services of Rs98cr) reported 29.8% YoY growth to Rs.1,704cr in Q2FY27 driven by 15% YoY volume growth and 13% YoY realisation growth.

Investment Rationale: Revenues grew by 2 7% YoY in H 1FY27; revenues to cross Rs6,000cr in FY27 : PGIL registered strong performance in H1FY27 with revenues and EBIDTA growing by 27% and 43% respectively.
Its volume grew by 18% YoY to 43.6mn pieces with growth across regions, while realisation grew by 9% to Rs718/piece.
